item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine has deployed naval drones to strike Russian warships in Libya’s Benghazi port, claiming lawful self-defence, while Russia has violated Finnish airspace with a helicopter and Polish airspace with an unmanned aerial vehicle. NATO’s chief has pledged defence against a Russian space threat after reports of a planned nuclear satellite, and MI5 has warned UK firms supplying Ukraine of sabotage risk. The UN Security Council warned that winter attacks on Ukraine’s power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies. 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
